description_en: Confirms the handling of a trojan scan alert
description_zh: 二次确认病毒扫描告警处置
name: ConfirmVirusEvents

parameters.help_en:
The method to handle the alert event. Valid values:

default: deep scan and removal
ignore: ignore
advance_mark_mis_info: add to whitelist
manual_handled: manually handled
parameters.help_zh:
告警事件的处理方式。取值：

default：深度查杀
ignore：忽略
advance_mark_mis_info：加白名单
manual_handled：我已手工处理
parameters.name: operation_code

parameters.help_en: The scope of the trojan scan alert handling. This parameter is required when OperationAll is set to 0. This parameter is ignored when OperationAll is set to 1
parameters.help_zh: 病毒防御告警的处置范围。当OperationAll为0时本参数必填，当OperationAll为1时本参数忽略
parameters.name: operation_range

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to handle all alerts. Valid values:
1: Yes.
0: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否全部处理。取值：
1：是
0：否
parameters.name: operation_all

RequestId.description_en: The unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Result.description_en:
The result of the request. Valid values:
true: succeeded.
false: failed
Result.description_zh:
请求处理结果。取值：
true：处理成功
false：处理失败
